children: Broadcom Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $29.59B and diluted EPS of $2.68, driven by strong demand for AI-related semiconductors and infrastructure software, and resulting in higher net income versus the prior year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Total net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by a surge in AI-related semiconductor product demand, with custom AI accelerators (XPUs) and AI networking as key contributors.
Direct sales to a single distributor accounted for roughly half of quarterly revenue, increasing customer concentration risk.
Infrastructure software showed momentum, led by VMware Cloud Foundation licenses and fewer termination-for-convenience contract occurrences.
Launched the AI XPV financing platform to support large-scale XPU rack deployments for frontier AI customers through 2028.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
